messages:
maria: Quick alert — blog post and benchmark publish set for TODAY 12:30 PT. small launch window, need last-minute alignment on copy + press list.
aj: Copy check — is the exec quote from Dr. Lin final? I have the 2nd para edited.
sam: Social posts queued for 12:32 PT, can hold to 12:45 if we need extra time. here's the threaded tweet text:
```
Now live: Redwood Inference launches Optimize — faster, cheaper LLM inference for production. Read more: <link>
Highlights: predictable latency, dedicated capacity, private deploys.
```
noah-design: Featured image ready, uploading 1200x675 jpeg now. alt text suggestion: "Engine room of inference — GPUs and charts".
elaine: Legal flag — we need to soften the storage line in the privacy blurb. current: "We do not store customer prompts." propose: "We do not retain prompts beyond inference unless configured." can legal sign off fast?
legal: Saw. Quick tweak: "We do not retain prompts beyond processing unless you enable storage for evaluation or support." Approve if product ok.
maria: Product OK with that wording. please update CMS copy before publish.
aj: Also note — one outlet (TechCrunch EU) asked for embargo lift and we need to remove them from the embargoed press list to avoid conflict. PR firm notified.
press-bot: Notified: third-party PR firm pinged (ticket #PR-5891).
sam: If CMS update happens after publish time we should: publish post, then delay announcing on X/LinkedIn until copy sync. fallback = hold social and email blast.
maria: Agreed. Priority: keep post live (SEO) but don't trigger outbound channels until legal + design green.
noah-design: Uploaded image v3 with corrected logo spacing at 12:10. please confirm alt text edit.
legal: Confirmed alt text ok. copy updated in CMS at 12:12.
aj: Final check: embed links, analytics tags, and the benchmark CSV attached? product asked to withhold raw CSV until later. leave links to high-level results only.
maria: Product ask noted — remove raw CSV link, keep visualized charts.
sam: Social scheduler switched to manual publish. I'll watch mentions and queue posts once you give the go.
maria: Okay team — if we hit any unexpected errors on publish, fallback = push post with placeholder note and notify partners. If all green, we go live and PR firm will release to media list at +5m.
aj: Ready on my end. standing by for final thumbs.
elaine: :thumbsup: final approval from legal at 12:14.
maria: GO in 2 mins. tagging: @sam @noah-design @aj @legal @press-bot.
press-bot: PR firm confirmed embargo lift schedule: distribution at 12:35 PT if GO.
sam: Publishing now. will delay social until explicit "announce" from maria.
maria: Post live. holding social. monitoring for press pickup. please report any clip below. :eyes:
aj: Seeing crawl in analytics — early traffic spike. nice.
noah-design: Creative looks good on preview.
press-bot: PR firm reports first pickup at +9m from VentureBeat.
maria: Thanks all. follow-up thread to track clip list and post-mortem in #marketing later.
